description: This file defines the DauxHelper class with static utility methods for path manipulation, URL handling, theme configuration, and file retrieval within a documentation site generator project.

classes.name: DauxHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for path normalization, URL slug generation, file path resolution, theme configuration, and internal file linking within the documentation system.

methods.name: rebaseConfiguration
methods.description: Sets a new base URL for the configuration and updates theme and image paths accordingly.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs theme configuration, including merging theme variants and applying substitutions.

methods.name: getCleanPath
methods.description: Removes all '/./' and '/../' segments from a path string without checking filesystem existence.

methods.name: getFilenames
methods.description: Generates possible output filenames for a source file based on valid extensions.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Locates a file in the directory tree based on a request path, handling relative paths and extensions.

methods.name: slugBase
methods.description: Converts a string to an ASCII-only base suitable for URL slugs.

methods.name: urlSlug
methods.description: Creates a URL-friendly slug from a string, replacing spaces and special characters.

methods.name: linkSlug
methods.description: Creates a URL-safe, lowercase slug with hyphens from a string.

methods.name: getRelativePath
methods.description: Calculates the relative filesystem path from one location to another.

methods.name: isAbsolutePath
methods.description: Checks if a given path is absolute.

methods.name: getAbsolutePath
methods.description: Returns an absolute path, resolving relative paths based on current working directory.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Checks if a path exists and matches a specified type ('dir' or file).

methods.name: resolveInternalFile
methods.description: Resolves an internal link to a file within the documentation tree, handling absolute and relative paths.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is non-empty and not a fragment identifier.

methods.name: isExternalUrl
methods.description: Determines if a URL is external based on its scheme.

methods.name: isDataUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a data URI for images.
